definitions: The action of directing someone's attention towards something by extending one's finger or an object.
The action of filling the joints of brickwork or masonry with mortar.
The action of aiming a weapon or camera at something.
The action of indicating a particular direction or position.
examples: She was pointing at the map.
The builder was pointing the new wall.
He was pointing the camera at the bird.
The sign was pointing towards the exit.
